dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave trailing edge exhibiting a smooth parabolic spline curvature from the posterior insertion point to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Moderate pixel radius with a distinctly rounded morphological classification.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep anterior margin contour, approximately 50-60 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge line.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small light-colored irregular notch or pigmentation mark on the mid-trailing edge of the dorsal fin; faint linear rake marks visible on the dark dorsal cape area.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent high-contrast pigment pattern consisting of a dark V-shaped 'cape' below the dorsal fin and lighter lateral thoracic and caudal patches.
